objective: Expose original-source exact residual/Jacobian enclosures, checked root boxes, and portable independent replay through the native Session and NDJSON CLI with cumulative protected verification budgets.

scope: parse_raw source domains and structural bounds
native source admission and canonical artifact transport
Session exact conversion, source/context binding and publication atomicity
independent_review.result: No remaining acceptance bypass found in bounded source review. This is not a completeness or whole-runtime claim.
resolved_findings: Flatten raw division chains to avoid unbounded recursive source trees.
Bound request IDs and reserve outer-envelope space before publication.
checked_boundaries: Original domains survive zero products, cancelled logarithms and undefined reciprocals.
Replay matches complete receiving typed sources, ordered symbol identities and context before decoding untrusted witnesses; untrusted Expr is never decoded.
Bounded witness decoding and canonical whole-artifact comparison precede independent core verification.
Protected compute cannot borrow ordinary compute; mixed resource charges are atomic and cumulative.
Verification or response admission failure leaves no accepted certificate; custom cancellation-aware meter tests cover every observed successful-path checkpoint.
independent_review.serializer_review: Pinned num-bigint 0.4.8 streams or borrows limbs. No extra replay preflight was added for hypothetical temporary digit allocation.

budget.scope: Actual fsym-budget crate; isolated cargo home and target, one build job, debug info disabled.

parser.scope: Actual workspace fsym-core parser tests, including both new raw parser regressions and nine existing cases.

scoped_native_session.scope: Validation-only manifest referenced actual root library, CLI, four integration-test files and native math crates. A separately named runtime facade referenced unchanged production workspace, protocol, publication, fmap and replay modules. It did not build complete production fsym-runtime. No mocked functions or substituted mathematical implementations were used.
important_observed_cases: Hand-derived rational residual/Jacobian and root-enclosure expectations
Fresh-process CLI export and independent replay
Source, symbol identity/order and assumption-context substitution refusal
Cancellation at every successful-path safe point
Cumulative protected fuel and failed-witness spending
Response-budget failure after successful verification leaves no certificate
Duplicate transport keys rejected before source publication
scoped_native_session.dependency_comparison: All 28 scoped external packages matched the original lock by name, version, source and checksum. No production source, dependency pin or gate was weakened.

post_validation_delta.change: Only four comment lines corrected the description of conservative serialization accounting. No executable statement changed.
post_validation_delta.verification: Replacing exactly those comment lines reproduced the tested SHA256; the other 13 direct source hashes matched.

workspace_gates.observed_failure: Pinned asupersync's rustc process received SIGKILL in both attempts. The 8 GiB cgroup was saturated and OOM kills were observed. No source diagnostic was reported; downstream workspace compilation remains unverified.

final_check_retry.detail: A locked/offline check with frontend/backend/linker concurrency capped at one ran, but ENOSPC prevented its recorder from preserving the result.

final_full_clippy_and_tests.detail: The direct-output runner could not launch after executor transport disconnected; recovery timed out and the environment became unavailable.

final_staged_planning_and_diff_check.detail: Environment loss prevented final validation. Staged TOML/JSONL were parsed and compared beforehand; only designated evidence references and note suffixes changed. Remote concurrent bead changes were then preserved by record-level three-way merge.

limitations: Complete production runtime, asupersync lifecycle, Cx/region cancellation, concurrent portfolios, persistence and repair remain unverified.
No Python extension or compatibility-profile execution is claimed by this record.
Witness checking does not provide automatic root search or close the complete certified Jacobian campaign.
